payload.body: critic-shell pass 5 on the v2g-to-v2h delta is back (TSP/critic0139-fifth-pass-v2h.txt): 0 critical, 3 warning, 2 rec, 4 style. v2g's W1, W2, rec 1 and rec 2 all driven FIXED (23 autotests shapes against cargo metadata; 26 standalone and 17 whole-cycle shapes for the resolver; all 19 new mutants killed at their intended assertions, none equivalent; 41 arms re-run ok). NEW: W1, DRIVEN, a FALSE GREEN in 0139's own code, contrived trigger: _fullcycle_tree_gone splits a link's content with read, which stops at a newline, so a link naming "$O/lk<LF>x/t" with lk<LF>x/ at 000 reads "does not exist", INCONCLUSIVE rc 0 (control without the newline: INCOMPLETE rc 1). By your rule this reopens 0139 as v2i. W2, by reading, 0139's own: Highlander -- _fullcycle_tree_gone is a second walk of a link chain beside follow_links (lib/helpers, 'THE ONE WALK'), without its newline lesson; the cause of W1. W3, DRIVEN, PRE-0139 (HEAD 4d8a9db does the same): a relative CARGO_TARGET_DIR is cargo's cwd-relative, and fullcycle reads it from the project root, so a build run from crate/ reads 'rel/t does not exist', INCONCLUSIVE rc 0; check targetdir already fails any relative value. I propose it is FILED, not taken into 0139 -- your call. Rec 1 (0139's own, loud): a link loop, an empty link, a 'Cargo.toml/' link and a 35-link chain are all named 'a directory on the way cannot be searched'. Rec 2: no arm holds _autotests_targets' _at_out=() reset (no two-crate arm). PLAN for v2i, light, unless you rule otherwise: one reader of a link's content, link_target in lib/helpers (readlink past a sentinel; refuses a content holding a newline, and one it cannot read back exactly, checked against the link's own size with find -size, which catches BSD's trailing-newline misread), used by follow_links and by _fullcycle_tree_gone (W1+W2); tree_gone returns 2 for a link it cannot follow, named as such (rec 1), and keeps a trailing slash (the Cargo.toml/ shape); a two-crate arm (rec 2); the 97-column line at check:542 (style); check:648's wording parked (pre-0139). Then the critic on the v2h-to-v2i delta, and START.
